onChange.template: [Category: movement] Apply the Dynamic art style to Air Control. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Smooth art style to Air Control. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.
[Category: movement] Apply the Precise art style to Air Control. After applying, update the gameplan to reflect the new appearance.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/air_control.schema.json, set acc_feel to {{acc_feel}}]
Set air control feel to {{acc_feel}} by adjusting airControlFactor in MovementAbility. Tight=1.0, Standard=2.0, Loose=4.0.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/movement/properties/air_control.schema.json, set act_air_control_factor to {{act_air_control_factor}}]
Set airControlFactor to {{act_air_control_factor}} in MovementAbility. Higher = harder to steer mid-air.
